atomic_facts.fact: China Evergrande Group was founded in 1996
China Evergrande Group was founded in Guangzhou
China Evergrande Group was founded by Hui Ka Yan
The head office of China Evergrande Group is located at No.78 Huangpu Avenue West, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, PRC
The postal code of the head office is 510620
On 29 January 2024, the High Court of Hong Kong made a winding-up order against China Evergrande Group
The winding-up order placed China Evergrande Group into liquidation
China Evergrande Group is undergoing formal liquidation proceedings under Hong Kong law
The liquidation was still ongoing as of 2026-10-01
The cited evidence shows no material adverse regulatory enforcement action against China Evergrande Group
The cited evidence shows no sanction against China Evergrande Group
The cited evidence shows no major civil judgment against China Evergrande Group
